sourceTitle: The Swiss Family Robinson, Told in Words of One Syllable
description: "The Swiss Family Robinson, Told in Words of One Syllable" by Mary Godolphin is a simplified adaptation of the classic adventure novel written during the early 19th century. The story follows the Robinson family, who find themselves shipwrecked on a deserted island.
